Activist Sonam Wangchuk Hospitalized Amid Hunger Strike; Support and Criticism Emerge

Environmental activist Sonam Wangchuk has been moved to a hospital after a 19-day hunger strike, during which he lost over 9kg. While some outlets report his condition as stable but weak due to dehydration, others question the police action. Support for Wangchuk has come from Bollywood personalities and opposition figures, with calls for government dialogue, while some student activists continue the protest.
